retrievalProfile.description: Produces chaotic, ink-splattered caricatures with distorted features and scratchy hand-lettering against a minimalist, textured background.
triggerTerms: splattered ink portrait with watercolor washes
excludeWhen: orderly and symmetrical layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A chaotic blend of aggressive ink linework, expressive splatters, and loose watercolor washes featuring two central distorted figures in a surreal desert landscape defined by horizontal perspective lines and jagged silhouettes.
coreVisualRelationships: Distorted central figures against a sparse, textured horizon
Aggressive black ink splatters contrasting with soft primary color washes
Scratchy, irregular hand-lettering integrated into the upper negative space
Jagged, silhouette-based secondary elements like cacti and birds framing the subjects
coreInvariants: Erratic, varying line weight with visible ink bleeds and splatters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupying the middle ground, scaled to fill approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The distorted faces of the subjects, emphasized by high-contrast ink detailing.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right typography, moves down through the central figures, and follows the horizontal perspective lines to the peripheral cacti.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white/off-white textured space in the upper half, providing breathing room for the chaotic ink elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white textured background providing a canvas for ink.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black ink for outlines, splatters, and silhouettes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary blue and yellow watercolor washes for clothing and small details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast black against white, with desaturated, bleeding color accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, white, primary blue, and primary yellow with minor green accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Scratchy, elongated sans-serif with irregular heights
letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a dip pen
Circular elements rendered as multiple overlapping loops
Extreme vertical elongation of certain characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: O characters rendered as concentric, shaky circles
H and J characters featuring long, thin descenders and ascenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive hand-drawn style paired with minimalist graphic icons.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, ink-heavy aesthetic of the reference.
Captures the jittery, expressive nature of the strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal desert scene with two distorted caricatures in ink and watercolor style. Include horizontal perspective lines, black ink splatters, and jagged cacti silhouettes. Leave the top right quadrant mostly empty with a textured off-white paper finish.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text in the top right using a scratchy black ink style with elongated characters and shaky circular 'O's.

verificationChecks: Are the ink splatters organic and varied?
Does the lettering feel hand-drawn rather than typeset?
Is the color palette limited to black, white, and primary accents?
Are the figures sufficiently distorted in a caricature style?

mustAchieve: Sense of chaotic energy within a minimalist composition

postGenerationChecks: Check for scratchy ink texture on all black lines
Ensure primary colors have a bleeding watercolor effect
Verify that typography is integrated as part of the art, not an afterthought
Confirm the presence of horizontal horizon lines for depth
Ensure the background has a subtle paper-like grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Distorted Ink Caricature + Watercolor Primary Accents + Scratchy Hand-Lettering + Minimalist Desert Horizon
